reasons.action: The brief asks for a specific depicted behavior — rain running down a bus window at night — and with no visual reference supplied there is no competing observed action, so the request owns the action.
reasons.medium: The medium owner is pinned by the schema to the no_reference decision: no supplied reference has authority over rendering, so the request governs the medium.
reasons.wardrobe: No figure or clothing is supplied by any reference, so nothing observed can own wardrobe; the request field governs by default.
reasons.lighting: The described night setting is scene context rather than a lighting instruction, but with no reference lighting to preserve the request nonetheless owns the lighting for this shot.
reasons.framing: The brief explicitly specifies a locked camera observing the window across exactly three shots, an actual camera composition and behavior, and no reference frame exists to override it.
reasons.palette: No reference supplies a color or tonal treatment, so the request governs the palette; the night setting alone is neither a hue nor a grade instruction.
